description: This file defines a Flutter widget called RecipeCard, which displays a recipe thumbnail, title, cuisine, cooking time, and diets within a styled card layout. It uses external dependencies such as material.dart from Flutter, a custom Thumbnail widget, and a Recipe model class.

classes.name: RecipeCard
classes.description: A stateless widget that displays detailed information about a recipe inside a card, including image, title, cuisine, cooking time, and dietary labels.

methods.name: RecipeCard
methods.description: Constructor for creating a RecipeCard widget, requiring a Recipe object and optionally an onTap callback.

methods.name: build
methods.description: Builds the widget tree for the RecipeCard, layouting the image, title, details, and tags within a Card and InkWell for tap interactions.
